candidate_relations.reason: The candidate correctly identifies lymphoma and notes retroperitoneal and skin involvement consistent with the clinical record, but it lacks the critical specificity of extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type — a distinct WHO entity defined by NK/T-cell lineage, EBV association, and characteristic extranodal presentation. Without these components the diagnosis is only a parent-level category.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names lymphoma with relevant anatomical involvement but does not specify the NK/T-cell lineage, nasal-type subtype, or extranodal designation required by the benchmark

case_quality_flags: Peripheral-blood flow cytometry unremarkable despite systemic lymphoma — consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma which often lacks circulating tumor cells
Adrenal and retroperitoneal masses noted 6 months prior were not evaluated, representing a missed diagnostic opportunity
Elevated muscle enzymes (CK, aldolase) with MRI-confirmed myositis suggest direct muscle infiltration by lymphoma
